verdict.rationale: Better Auth's docs list magic link, passkey, and email-otp as first-party sign-in plugins. The homepage shows a `passkey()` plugin in config and advertises "Passkeys, magic links". A hands-on community report says adding passkeys took about 7 lines of server code. The 2FA OTP feature is a second factor, not passwordless sign-in, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth plugin documentation for the magic link and email OTP flows (the evidence gives only brief mentions), and independent or hands-on corroboration for magic links and email OTP.
